Hospitality Training for Immigrant Women – February 9 2026 to May 1, 2026

Delivered in collaboration with Southern Alberta Institute of Technology (SAIT), this 12-week fulltime program helps immigrant women develop and enhance their employability skills in the hospitality and tourism industry.
